newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila warns ships of Tropical storm Peter.
newsitem.headline: Manila warns ships of Tropical storm Peter.

text.p: Tropical storm Peter (local name Daling), packing winds of up to 90 kph per hour, may cause stormy weather in central and northern Luzon provinces starting on Wednesday, the Philippine weather bureau said.

Coastal waters maybe rough and dangerous to all ships in the provinces of Catanduanes, Albay, Sorsogon, Camarines and Polilio islands, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) said on Tuesday.
The storm will also bring rains and winds of not more than 60 kph today and tomorrow in Eastern Visayas, and the provinces of Masbate, Quezon, Aurora, Quirino, Isabela and Cagayan.
Coastal waters will be moderate to rough in these areas, it said.
The storm is forecast to be 240 km east of Virac, Catanduanes or 500 km east southeast of Casiguran, Aurora by tomorrow morning, the weather bureau said.
